model_annotation: The pie chart visually represents responses to a survey question asking how respondents agree with the statement "Design is well integrated into the product development process in our organization," showing five distinct categories with corresponding numerical values: “It started to be integrated” (blue, 10), “Very well integrated” (orange, 24), “Well integrated” (green, 25), “Poorly integrated” (red, 8), and “Not integrated this way” (purple, 20). The chart is accompanied by a legend that maps each colored slice to its respective category label and count. The slices appear arranged in a clockwise descending order of size, starting from the largest green slice (“Well integrated”) at the bottom, followed by the orange (“Very well integrated”), purple (“Not integrated this way”), blue (“It started to be integrated”), and smallest red (“Poorly integrated”) at the top. No percentage labels are shown within the slices, and none of the slices are visually emphasized or exploded.
